review_notes: Gate 1 provenance: human supplied school_ref=juilliard, admission_cycle=Fall 2026, and scope=Vocal Arts pilot limited to four Voice program-degree pages on 2026-07-18.
Scope is supplied-corpus-only: Voice BM, MM, GD, and DMA. The separate Opera Studies Artist Diploma page and every non-Vocal-Arts program were excluded.
The source tables print month/day deadlines without years. Dates are normalized to 2025/2026 from the approved Fall 2026 entry cycle and require independent review before publication.
The DMA page conflicts internally: its timeline table says February 16 for dossier and graded paper, while the body says February 15. Both values are retained; neither is silently selected.

The MM and GD source timelines list SAT/ACT scores for homeschooled applicants by December 2, while their detailed Additional Requirements sections contain no homeschooled-applicant section; the conditional milestones are retained with the inconsistency noted.
TOEFL minimums are dual-scaled around 21 January 2026. Integer fields store the pre-change scale (73/89/102); the new-scale values (4/4.5/5) are preserved in conditional notes and source evidence.

portfolio_required is Unknown for BM/MM/GD because section absence is not an explicit negative. DMA uses Not Required as the base case, with its dossier becoming required only after an audition invitation.
All four pages were captured on 2026-07-17, after the target Fall 2026 application cycle; freshness must be reviewed before any production use.

T1b (2026-08-03): schools.country_code set to "US" by deterministic ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 lookup on the already-sourced canonical `country` field ("United States"); this is a computed code, not an independently sourced new fact, so no source_records row was added for it.

All four program_offerings already carry language_of_instruction=["English"], but no dedicated official statement declaring the school-level instruction language was located; filling it from inference alone would violate extraction discipline, so it stays null pending a source.

T1b (2026-08-03): degree_levels.degree_level_name_zh filled for bm/mm/gd/dma (音乐学士/音乐硕士/研究生文凭/音乐艺术博士) using standard, generic Chinese academic-degree terminology, not a Juilliard-specific claim. These are proposed values for the user-maintained controlled vocabulary and should be confirmed/added to the Directus degree_levels seed table, not treated as independently web-sourced facts.

T1b (2026-08-03): tuition_currency/tuition_amount_min/tuition_amount_max/tuition_period filled for all four programs (USD 57,200/year) from juilliard.edu's 2026-27 Tuition, Fees, and Expenses page, retrieved 2026-08-03. The prior placeholder figure of $53,300 referenced in T2 test fixtures/docs was never stored in this production package (all four tuition fields were null) and needed no correction here.

T1b (2026-08-03) CAVEAT on juilliard_voice_dma tuition (superseded by the 2026-08-03 human ruling below — kept for the audit trail): the official page states "Doctor of Musical Arts program (any major)" (along with Artist Diploma, Historical Performance, and MFA Acting) is "tuition-free or offer[s] full-tuition scholarships to all admitted applicants." The $57,200 sticker figure was initially recorded as-is with this caveat rather than being nulled; see the following note for the resolution.

T1b/T2c (2026-08-03, human ruling): DMA full-tuition-waiver finding accepted as the correct handling of a real gap — Directus schema needs a new program_offerings.funding_policy field (enum: full_tuition_waiver_all_admitted / partial / none / null; nullable) so Mode F can render "录取者全额学费减免(官网公布)" instead of a misleading RMB range when tuition is fully waived for every admit. That field does not exist yet, so as an interim measure juilliard_voice_dma's tuition_currency/tuition_amount_min/tuition_amount_max/tuition_period were reset from USD 57,200/per_year back to null on 2026-08-03 (the source_records evidencing $57,200 for DMA are kept, tagged review_status: Needs Review, for reuse once funding_policy lands). Rationale: publishing an unqualified "约 57–60 万元人民币" figure for a program that is actually free for every admitted student is a worse failure than showing no cost block at all. juilliard_voice_bm/mm/gd are unaffected and keep tuition_amount = 57200. T2c is tracked in T2_REVIEW_HANDOFF.md's 后续动作 section; not implemented in this session (schema + Mode F code change requires its own review cycle, out of scope for a T1b data-only session).

T1b (2026-08-03): degree_level_name_zh confirmed by human ruling (bm→音乐学士、mm→音乐硕士、gd→研究生文凭、dma→音乐艺术博士) for propagation into the Directus degree_levels seed table by whoever holds write access; this package's own degree_levels array already carries the confirmed values, so Mode F output in this package is unaffected by the pending upstream sync.

T2c (2026-08-05, per the 2026-08-03 human ruling): program_offerings.funding_policy has landed, so the T1b interim workaround on juilliard_voice_dma is reverted. tuition_currency/tuition_amount_min/tuition_amount_max/tuition_period are restored to USD 57,200/per_year from the same juilliard.edu 2026-27 Tuition, Fees, and Expenses page that already backs the other three programs (the $57,200 source_records rows were retained for exactly this), and funding_policy is set to "full_tuition_waiver_all_admitted". Mode F now renders the cost block as 形态④ — fixed wording 「录取者全额学费减免(官网公布)」, no RMB interval, no components — instead of relying on null tuition columns to suppress the block. juilliard_voice_bm/mm/gd keep funding_policy null (未声明): the official page names DMA, Artist Diploma, Historical Performance and MFA Acting as tuition-free and says nothing about the other three, and "none" would be an assertion the source does not make.
